description_en: Updates the attributes of an egress proxy rule group
name: UpdateEgressProxyRuleGroupAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

Note If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run and does not update the rule group. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, the system returns an error. If the request passes the dry run, the system returns the DryRunOperation error code.

false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and performs the operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会更新规则组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 HTTP 2xx 状态码并直接执行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress proxy rule group that you want to update
parameters.help_zh: 要更新的出口规则组的 ID
parameters.name: egress_proxy_rule_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the egress proxy rule group. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 出口规则组名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: egress_proxy_rule_group_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the egress proxy rule group. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
出口规则组的描述信息。
长度为 2~256 个字符，可包含中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress IP pool that is associated with the egress proxy rule group. After you specify this parameter, the egress IP pool is associated with the egress proxy rule group
parameters.help_zh: 出口规则组关联的出口地址池的 ID。指定后，会将该出口地址池关联到出口规则组
parameters.name: egress_proxy_ip_pool_id
